steps.title: Analyze compilation and runtime crashes
steps.description: Identify missing GLSurfaceView OpenGL ES initialization configuration causing immediate crash on launch, and ensure proper context version selection.

steps.title: Configure OpenGL ES 2.0 context
steps.description: Add setEGLContextClientVersion(2) to MainActivity to prevent initialization and runtime crashes from GLES 1.x defaults.

steps.title: Refactor GL Renderer to client-side NIO buffers
steps.description: Refactor buffer generation using direct float/short buffers to prevent platform-specific driver bugs and VBO binding crashes.

steps.title: Enable Depth Buffer and Face Ordering
steps.description: Ensure GLES20.GL_DEPTH_TEST is enabled during surface setup and cleared inside the render loop for reliable 3D rendering.

steps.title: Align and map vertex attributes dynamically
steps.description: Enable and bind vertex attributes dynamically based on program locations to ensure broad compatibility across multiple GPUs.

steps.title: Synchronize vertex colors to vertex indices
steps.description: Ensure color mapping size matches exactly with 8 coordinate vertices to prevent index-out-of-bounds rendering crashes.

steps.title: Verify Java compatibility rules
steps.description: Ensure no lambdas, streams, or post-Java 8 features are present in the rendering source code.

steps.title: Verify local layout parameters and lifecycle integration
steps.description: Confirm onResume and onPause are correctly forwarding state commands to prevent OpenGL state leaks.

steps.title: Sanity check manifest elements
steps.description: Verify application attributes, theme config, and permissions conform to correct structure.

steps.title: Building 3D Cube Runner
steps.description: Trigger final compilation to produce a crash-free, high-performance 3D Cube application.
